name: ping-identity-pingone-aic
description: Agent plugin for PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (AIC) single-tenant. Includes skills and a remote MCP server that lets AI agents configure and monitor your AIC environments.
suggestedPrompts: Create a new AIC journey that prompts for username and password but also allows login and registration of FIDO2 passkeys.
Check the last 24 hours of authentication attempts and tell me if anyone has been locked out of their account.
Help me connect to Entra ID to provision users into my AIC tenant.
